milestones.result: FINAL DELIVERABLE: scratchpad/aria-demo/aria-demo-narrated.mp4 (3.8MB, 1m40s, 1920x1080 h264 + AAC 22050Hz mono, verified via full-decode pass with zero errors + volumedetect confirming real speech audio [mean -21.9dB, max -1.4dB, not silence]). Voiceover pipeline: macOS `say` produces files with ZERO real audio bytes in this environment (confirmed via afinfo: "audio bytes: 0") - a genuine environment limitation, not a false excuse. Used espeak-ng instead (free, local, no credential risk - deliberately did NOT reach for the .env.local ElevenLabs key since it's flagged in the relay findings as needing rotation). Hit and fixed two real ffmpeg bugs during the rebuild: (1) `ffmpeg -i file` alone always exits 1 (no output specified) which under `set -e -o pipefail` silently killed the duration-measurement pipeline - fixed with an explicit `|| true` guard; (2) literal single-quote characters wrapping the drawtext text= value broke this ffmpeg build's filter parser (even for plain "HELLO") - fixed by dropping the quotes and keeping backslash-escaping for `:`/`,` only. 14 scenes, narration duration measured per-clip and clip length auto-extended to fit (never cuts off speech). Original non-narrated cut (aria-demo.mp4) kept alongside as a backup. Neither file committed to git or shared anywhere.
